user_input: Write a JavaScript Code to iterate over an array
model_output:
Here is a sample JavaScript code to iterate over an array:


```var myArray = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5];

for (var i = 0; i < myArray.length; i++) {
  console.log(myArray[i]);
}
```

In this code, we declare an array `` myArray `` containing five elements. We then use a `` for `` loop to iterate over the elements in the array, using the `` length `` property to determine the number of iterations. Within the loop, we use the `` i `` variable to index into the array and retrieve each element. Finally, we use the `` console.log `` method to log each element to the console.

The output of this code will be:


```1
2
3
4
5
```
